plain: To secretly work together to cheat or deceive others.

webster.text: To play into the hand of each other; to conspire in a fraud; to act in concert.

example.quote: They might otherwise have colluded, and opinions have been given too much under his hifluence.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. IREDELL, July 28, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
